feature.name: JobPilot: Daily 09:00 AM Curation & 1-Tap Apply
feature.summary: A job seeker opens the 09:00 AM Telegram job card, optionally previews a zero-hallucination LaTeX resume, and taps 1-Tap Apply for off-screen ShadowMux submission.

segments.name: Newcomer who has not finished vault or desktop setup

hypotheses.text: Daily Engagement: at least 85% of eligible candidates open and review the 09:00 AM Telegram card.
Application Confirmation Rate: at least 40% of candidates who open a card finish applying.
Execution Cycle Time: median time from opening the card to stamped receipt is 45 seconds or less.
Trust threshold: at least half of candidates who reach 1-Tap Apply proceed to submit.

variants.name: Queue application when desktop ShadowMux is asleep
variants.note: Instead of blocking mobile commuters whose laptop is closed, queue the 1-tap apply request and run it automatically when ShadowMux reconnects.

variants.name: Show tailored bullets & custom answers before 1-Tap Apply
variants.note: Include a compact summary of the 6 selected bullets and pre-filled EEO/custom answers under the card so cautious engineers trust what will be submitted.

variants.name: Pre-draft grounded answers for custom ATS questions
variants.note: Auto-answer standard custom ATS fields (sponsorship, notice period, why company) from the verified vault so fewer runs escalate to mobile HITL.

edge_cases.step_name: Whole flow
edge_cases.title: Signed out while in the flow
edge_cases.question: After signing in again, do they return to where they were?
edge_cases.expected: If the desktop ATS SSO session or Telegram auth expires mid-apply, pause and prompt re-auth in ShadowMux/Telegram without losing the tailored PDF or form state.

edge_cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
edge_cases.title: The other system returns an error
edge_cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
edge_cases.expected: If Tectonic is missing or LaTeX compilation fails (compiler.py currently returns .tex path), surface a clear error and never send raw .tex as a PDF preview.

edge_cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
edge_cases.title: No connection
edge_cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
edge_cases.expected: If the user taps 1-Tap Apply on mobile while desktop ShadowMux is asleep or offline, queue the job and notify the user when the desktop worker picks it up.

edge_cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
edge_cases.title: The other system returns an error
edge_cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
edge_cases.expected: If ShadowMux daemon crashes or Chrome fails to spawn at (-3200,-3200), release any partial lock and notify Telegram with a manual apply link.

edge_cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
edge_cases.title: Half of it worked
edge_cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
edge_cases.expected: If SQLite lease is acquired but cookie mirroring fails, release the lease immediately so the domain is not locked for 120s TTL.

edge_cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
edge_cases.title: No connection
edge_cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
edge_cases.expected: If network drops mid-autofill, abort before Submit, release the ShadowMux lease, and offer a retry without risking partial form submission.

edge_cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
edge_cases.title: The other system returns an error
edge_cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
edge_cases.expected: If the ATS returns 4xx/5xx or rejects the PDF upload format/size, capture the error banner screenshot and notify Telegram.

edge_cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
edge_cases.title: Button pressed twice
edge_cases.question: Can a double press create two records, charges or messages?
edge_cases.expected: Check the local applications ledger (UNIQUE job_id) and disable the Telegram 1-Tap Apply button immediately after first confirmation.

edge_cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
edge_cases.title: Half of it worked
edge_cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
edge_cases.expected: If fields fill but file upload fails, escalate to HITL with the partial form intact rather than submitting without a resume.

edge_cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
edge_cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
edge_cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
edge_cases.expected: Verify the requisition is still open (not 404/closed) before filling; if closed overnight, mark expired and surface tomorrow's #2 role.

edge_cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
edge_cases.title: No connection
edge_cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
edge_cases.expected: Never blindly retry Submit after a network drop; check ATS confirmation email/page state first or escalate to human verification.

edge_cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
edge_cases.title: No answer in time
edge_cases.question: After how long does it give up, and what can the user do then?
edge_cases.expected: After clicking Submit, poll up to 30s for confirmation; on timeout, save a screenshot and mark status='uncertain_needs_check' instead of failing.

edge_cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
edge_cases.title: The other system returns an error
edge_cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
edge_cases.expected: Parse inline ATS validation errors (e.g. invalid phone format) and route to HITL instead of generic failure.

edge_cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
edge_cases.title: Half of it worked
edge_cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
edge_cases.expected: If ATS accepted the submission but local SQLite write or screenshot failed, still record the confirmation code from browser DOM and retry DB write.

edge_cases.step_name: Solves CAPTCHA or custom question via Telegram link
edge_cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation
edge_cases.question: If the step fails or the user steps back, is what they typed kept?
edge_cases.expected: If the 180s HITL window expires or the mobile webview reloads, persist any typed custom essay answers locally and allow resuming.

edge_cases.step_name: Solves CAPTCHA or custom question via Telegram link
edge_cases.title: 180-second HITL timer expires before user finishes
edge_cases.question: What happens to the detached browser tab, lease, and typed answers when the 180s timeout fires?
edge_cases.expected: Save typed answers, release the ShadowMux lease cleanly, and send a 'Resume on desktop' option instead of silently dropping.

edge_cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
edge_cases.title: ATS sponsorship / visa question does not match boolean preset
edge_cases.question: How are nuanced multi-option work authorization dropdowns mapped when preset is a single string?
edge_cases.expected: Escalate ambiguous visa/sponsorship dropdowns to HITL instead of guessing a legally binding answer.

edge_cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
edge_cases.title: Tectonic/pdflatex binary missing on host
edge_cases.question: apps/jobpilot/compiler.py falls back to writing .tex path into pdf_path. What does Telegram send?
edge_cases.expected: Fail fast at setup/lint or ship bundled Tectonic binary; never attach a .tex file as a resume upload to an ATS.

edge_cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
edge_cases.title: No connection
edge_cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
edge_cases.expected: Pre-compiled PDFs cached locally at 08:58 AM should queue cleanly in Telegram and deliver when connectivity returns; show a clear offline status if requested on demand.

edge_cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
edge_cases.title: Half of it worked
edge_cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
edge_cases.expected: If PDF renders but fails pdftotext containment or >1-page overflow check after pruning, block preview and alert the user instead of sending a broken PDF.

edge_cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
edge_cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
edge_cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
edge_cases.expected: If the user edits master_bullets after 08:58 AM pre-compilation, invalidate the cached PDF before sending Preview.

edge_cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
edge_cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
edge_cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
edge_cases.expected: If the user logged into the ATS in their visible Chrome after ShadowMux started, re-sync cookies before navigating.

edge_cases.step_name: Reads daily Telegram match card

edge_cases.question: Can the user mark 'Already applied' on the card without penalizing the company/skills in Skip calibration?

moments.thought: One card at 9am with salary and matched skills is way calmer than LinkedIn alerts.
Had to download the PDF to see which bullets it picked. Took a moment to open in mobile viewer.
Got the confirmation screenshot in Telegram. Didn't touch a single Lever box.

sessions.quote: Once it worked, it felt like magic—though I only trusted it after opening the PDF.
sessions.unmet_need: Show the 6 selected bullets right in the Telegram message so I don't always have to open a PDF.

sessions.persona: Elena, Staff Systems Engineer not actively looking (User 1)
sessions.context: mobile, good network, greenhouse, verified_vault, shadowmux_online, missing clean_ats_fields
sessions.goal: Glance at a high-match role without risking her reputation on sloppy AI answers

moments.thought: 93% match, great company. What will it actually type into Greenhouse's custom questions?
There is only '1-Tap Apply' or 'Skip'. I can't tweak one bullet or review the form answers before it fires.

themes.title: 09:00 AM mobile Telegram delivery collides with desktop-only ShadowMux execution
themes.evidence: Vikram tapped 1-Tap Apply on the move while his laptop was asleep and hit a dead end at acquire_shadowmux (41% of users lack shadowmux_online at 09:00 AM).
themes.recommendation: Queue 1-Tap Apply requests locally/via relay and run automatically when desktop ShadowMux comes online, instead of failing or blocking.

themes.title: Unverified newcomers and missing-vault users hit a hard wall on day one
themes.evidence: Tarun was blocked at read_job_card because JobPilot requires an approved master bullet vault with no onboarding fallback in the daily dispatch loop.
themes.recommendation: Route users with incomplete vaults to a fast inline onboarding prompt before expecting 09:00 AM daily cards.

themes.title: High-bar engineers want light control before an irreversible submission
themes.evidence: Elena and Daniel both abandoned at confirm_1tap_apply because they could not inspect custom ATS field answers or swap a bullet.
themes.recommendation: Show the 6 chosen bullets and pre-filled EEO/custom answers in Telegram with a quick swap option before 1-Tap Apply.

themes.title: HITL escalation turns '30-second autopilot' into a timed mobile essay
themes.evidence: Maya hit a custom Greenhouse essay prompt via hitl_escalation and quit under the 180s timeout pressure.
themes.recommendation: Pre-draft grounded answers from the verified vault and allow 'Save draft & finish on desktop' instead of a hard 180s timeout.

spec_gaps.title: Desktop ShadowMux offline when user taps 1-Tap Apply on mobile
spec_gaps.detail: The proposal pushes Telegram cards at 09:00 AM (mobile commute time) but assumes desktop Chrome/ShadowMux is awake and reachable.

spec_gaps.title: What happens after the 180-second HITL CAPTCHA/question timeout
spec_gaps.detail: User Story 8 specifies waiting up to 180s for human resolution, but never defines whether state is saved, retried, or discarded after timeout.

spec_gaps.title: Ambiguous outcome if confirmation-page scraping fails after clicking Submit
spec_gaps.detail: If network drops or ATS DOM changes after clicking Submit, the spec does not say how JobPilot verifies whether the application went through without double-submitting.

spec_gaps.title: Compiler fallback returns .tex source when tectonic/pdflatex is absent
spec_gaps.detail: In apps/jobpilot/compiler.py, missing TeX binaries assign out_tex_path to result.pdf_path, which would fail or send raw LaTeX on Preview PDF.
